name: Quenza
short_description: Client engagement and digital homework platform for therapists and coaches, featuring customizable activities, pathways, and outcome tracking with white-label branding.
long_description: Quenza is a practitioner-focused client engagement platform designed to extend care between sessions through digital activities, homework assignments, and psychoeducation. The platform features a drag-and-drop Activity Builder for creating custom interventions, pre-built activity templates based on evidence-based approaches (CBT, ACT, mindfulness), and automated Pathways for sequenced client journeys. Quenza supports outcome tracking through custom forms and assessments, secure client messaging, reflection journals, and group activities. The platform offers white-label branding allowing practitioners to customize the client experience with their own logo and colors. Quenza is popular among therapists, psychologists, counselors, and coaches seeking to increase client engagement and track progress between appointments.
one_liner: Client engagement platform with digital homework and customizable activities for therapists and coaches.

faqs.q: What is Quenza used for in therapy?
faqs.a: Quenza is used to extend therapeutic care between sessions through digital homework assignments, psychoeducation activities, reflection journals, and automated pathways. It helps increase client engagement and track progress.
Quenza offers three tiers: Lite at $49/month (annual), Standard at $69/month (annual) with white-label branding, and Unlimited at $99/month (annual) for teams. A 30-day free trial is available.
Yes, Quenza is HIPAA compliant and provides Business Associate Agreements (BAAs) for US healthcare providers. It is also GDPR compliant with data encryption and secure AWS hosting.

faqs.q: Can I create custom activities in Quenza?
faqs.a: Yes, Quenza features a drag-and-drop Activity Builder for creating custom digital activities with text, images, video, audio, questions, scales, and electronic signatures.
